name: Environmental Engineering
notes: A coherent sequence of 16 credits plus a required background course. Students need a GPA of at least 2.0 to declare.
PREREQUISITES: one semester of chemistry, two semesters of calculus and one semester of physics. AP equivalents or instructor approval are acceptable.
Substitutions the page allows: ME 123 for CHE 225, ME 225 for CHE 243, ME 223 for CHE 244.
The objective is core technical proficiency in environmental engineering analysis.

requirementGroups.label: Required background
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Minor in Environmental Engineering. Required Background: CHE 150: Intro to Sustainabile Energy OR EESC 103: Introduction to Environmental Science

requirementGroups.label: Sixteen credits of environmental engineering coursework
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Choose 16 Credits. No more than 12 credits can be taken from one department. Students not majoring in engineering should take 12 credits in engineering courses (CHE or ME). Students majoring in engineering should take 12 of the 16 credits in non-engineering courses (EES, BIO, PHLT).
requirementGroups.note: BALANCE RULE NOT ENFORCED: no more than 12 of the 16 credits may come from one department, and the engineering/non-engineering split runs OPPOSITE ways depending on your major - engineering majors take 12 credits OUTSIDE engineering, everyone else takes 12 credits INSIDE it. Check your own split.
